title: Eclipsed Clock
description:
An eclipsed clock allows you to change the time of day. After you hang it on a wall you can right click it to increase its target time by 600 ticks (half a minute of in-game time per click) and shift right click to decrease it. The target time is shown as a clock time above the clock for a few seconds after a click, and whenever you look at it.

Right clicking it with a Time in a Bottle will consume the time needed to reach the target from the bottle and move the time of day forward to that of the clock (never backwards, so the wait can be up to a full day). The time does not jump: it speeds forward for up to about 12 seconds while particles and a chime play. If the bottle does not hold enough time, nothing happens.

properties.label: Obtain
properties.value: Crafted (see recipe); the Ghast Tear is part of the recipe

properties.label: Placement
properties.value: Hangs on the side of a wall, not on floor or ceiling

properties.label: Skip speed
properties.value: 100 ticks of day time per server tick, up to about 12 seconds for a full day
